messages:
emma-sales: Quick ask from ProspectCorp: they want a POC with Redwood where control plane lives in EU only, inference runs inside their Canada colo, BYO-KMS (HSM possible), and no outgoing request payload egress. Need feasibility + rough SOW delta + short ops checklist.

kevin-eng: Technically ok using Redwood Private + customer-managed data plane. Two modes: 1) weights stay on their network -> we ship onprem runtime + signed update flow; 2) weights hosted but encrypted -> requires cross-border storage consent. Telemetry can be reduced to a heartbeat.

polly-privacy: For security questionnaire we need the full sub-processor list and confirmation of HSM requirement. HSM adds attestation and vendor checks. If they require zero telemetry, we'll document support limitations. 72h to produce KMS control-flow diagram after confirm.

matt-sre: Networking: control-plane endpoints restricted to eu-west1, data-plane in customer CA colo. Mutual TLS required; cert rotation + monitoring hooks take ~2 days. Airgap packaging adds ~3 more days. Proposed routing yaml snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  control_plane: eu-west1
  data_plane: onprem-ca-central1
  failover: disabled unless customer approves cross-border
  egress: restrict_to_customer_cidrs: true
```

emma-sales: Pricing ballpark for sales deck? One-time packaging, BYO-KMS integration, recurring private fee.

kevin-eng: Prelim numbers: Private seat +$6k/mo; onprem packaging (one-time) $25k; BYO-KMS integration $8k (HSM add-on +$10k); ops handoff $4k. First-month uplift ~ $45k with HSM, recurring +$6k/mo. Note: final after eng/legal signoff.

billing-bot: Noted. Will prepare SOW stub and tax/reg notes for Canada in 48h.

emma-sales: Action list: 1) @kevin-eng confirm whether any metadata must be present in EU control plane (EOD). 2) @polly-privacy produce sub-processor + KMS flow (72h). 3) @matt-sre provide cert rotation plan and ops ETA (48h). I'll schedule the customer call after this. :thumbsup:
